annotations.title: Start taking over a lost-key agent

description: Recover after an agent's key was lost (host or renter): name the old agent's DID. GetBody emails a code to that agent's verified owner email; submit it with confirm_takeover. Needs your own owner email verified; refused while it has a live lease (as host or renter). Works while pending.
name: take_over_agent
